resources.string: Grant permissions, allow the overlay, exempt from battery saver, then arm the monitor. It stays on after restarts. Speakerphone records both voices; with the phone at your ear only your side is recorded. After you hang up, the call is transcribed on the phone and a pop-up suggests follow-up messages. Use Demo pop-up to test the overlay without a call.
Transcription (Groq when a key is saved below, else offline)

Pick Groq and paste your free Groq key: it then writes the replies AND transcribes calls (Whisper), which is much better for Hindi and Hinglish. With Groq, call audio and text go to Groq. With no key, everything stays offline on the phone.
Get a free key for this provider
Do this once so speakerphone calls can label your lines as \"You\" and the other person\'s as \"Them\". Without it they show as Speaker 1 and Speaker 2.
